notes.title: New Alpha Version of Any World Now Available!
notes.content:
[h2]Dear friends![/h2]

We are excited to announce that after a two-year break, we have finally released a new alpha version of Any World! The last update was in 2023, and since then the game has undergone tremendous changes.

[previewyoutube=YNrpsKYkxgs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What's new:[/h2]

🏙 EmriTown — a full-fledged location with a unique visual style and plenty of secrets

👥 New characters — meet the charismatic residents of EmriTown, each with their own story

💰 Collectibles — explore every corner of the city in search of chests and coins

🎮 All of Ottis's core abilities — try out the main character's full arsenal of capabilities, including glove modules and special movements

🌟 Additional level — complete a special level that will test your platforming skills and gadget handling

This alpha version reflects our vision for the final product and demonstrates the key mechanics that will form the foundation of the full game. We look forward to your feedback, which will help us make Any World even better!

Thank you for your patience and support!

The IdeaGame Team

notes.title: Any World results for 2024
notes.content:
[h1]Dear friends![/h1]
We are excited to share with you the results of our work on Any World over the past year! 2024 has been a period of massive improvements and game reimagining for us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42019926/9f1b54912e1f97ed2354fd1c2adc7a446960f1cb.png[/img]
[h1]🎨Character and Concept Updates[/h1]
We have completely redesigned all characters, from the main hero Ottis to the regular NPCs you'll meet while exploring the world of Any World! The game concept has been enhanced: each of the 7 locations now features its own unique visual style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42019926/5aae4fd42dfacbccc8da4e56b964df5f342d18bd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42019926/353d50a0fdffe28b851703b4aec366f24be36d28.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42019926/d2e13b9cecce114c86ef69d3b5178c032293c271.png[/img]
[h1]🎮Technical Improvements[/h1]
We have completed work on core gameplay mechanics, which has allowed us to optimize the gameplay and improve player interaction with the world. New elements have been added, such as unique character abilities and progression systems, along with balance adjustments to ensure an engaging gaming experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42019926/ba3a49cf95d4f0b2100f903297dea1d3f688b5e6.png[/img]
[h1]✏️Visual Improvements[/h1]
Furthermore, the level design has been significantly improved: many maps have been reworked based on player feedback, creating more interesting levels with unique challenges. A new intuitive user interface simplifies navigation and interaction. These changes substantially enhance the quality of the gaming experience and strengthen the game's market competitiveness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42019926/e00757a7bd9ef06168d03893731f4aa684ec676a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42019926/731f88f7679cce0edf7b3dd6ffe94d4100424585.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42019926/1c64ded6a7de47c02648f30d4ff27a3eef79e2ab.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42019926/8e4177c727707164e229cc7030e0edc548efd46c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42019926/2597131b467ebe220933a13e6a8f1206ae87a7c1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42019926/d3b15d50c43692931316542bbd0e74fcb3240a92.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42019926/f91800f2f44c7d1b1d505a41d1decd80e28e1229.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42019926/e25956efecc8b631dad89955d75031d5444415b7.png[/img]
[h1]📖Content and Media[/h1]
The game's story has been updated and expanded, adding new storylines and character depth, making the gameplay more engaging. We've created many new character renders, improving their visual perception and helping better convey their personalities. Some of the art is still under development, but in 2025 you will be able to see them all.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42019926/aaa96dca331458523374ac19f2cdac4f5dc1bfa1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42019926/31a600c0b01e0227dcaf17f8a2d62d2431be633d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42019926/c6ea71524a588e3d36e8afe5d970824b523c31e1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42019926/eec74f752de750ab0285b6c8dc230661e5eac13c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42019926/a1888410014e52162f8616ac5a5073c17f02e548.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42019926/dab9b5ff19ab768f673dd72a369de6118a318485.png[/img]
A unique brand identity has been developed, unifying all visual elements into a single concept, making the game easily recognizable. We've also prepared a comprehensive press kit with high-quality images and descriptions of key features, which will help effectively promote the game and attract attention from both players and media. All these changes significantly enrich the game and strengthen its market position.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42019926/8900ce6583abfe2603a205ddf112f60bc7cdb6d0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42019926/d21c35e692f7d3ffe421cad2ced25b7d081bc625.png[/img]
[h1]🌐What's Next?[/h1]
The official game website will launch soon, where you'll find all the latest news, updates, and project information. We're preparing to release a new demo version that will let you be the first to evaluate our achievements and new gameplay mechanics.
Thank you for staying with us and following the project's development in [url=https://bsky.app/profile/anyworld3d.bsky.social]BLUEKSY[/url]! 2025 promises to be even more eventful and full of surprises, including new ways to interact with the game and its world. We are confident that exciting adventures and unforgettable moments await you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42019926/74cb1612f9606dcc9fd825e68a943b7413f6a5b1.png[/img]
[h1]Best wishes,
The Any World Team 🚀
Happy New Year!❤️❤️[/h1]

notes.title: DEMO VERSION! The Rebirth of Any World!
notes.content:
Hello everyone I am glad to share with you the news that very soon we will release a big update of the demo version of Any World, or rather a practical completely redesigned game.

What will be in the new demo version:

[list]
[*]Bug fix
[*]New graphics
[*]New models
[*]A completely new plot
[*]Test map, part of the world
[*]30 minutes of gameplay
[*]Secrets
[/list]

This is just a part of the demo version that we can reveal now, the rest you will see for yourself.

For a whole year we completely changed everything in Any World and tried to come to a conditional ideal of the game, there were a lot of different ideas, concepts that we eventually used, then changing them very much, but as a result, it is now clear for sure that the game has become and will be even better than in 2022!

Expect new news soon.

Our team, IdeaGame.
